name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A tool that automatically builds a command-line 'remote control' for other software, so an AI agent can operate programs that were never designed for AI to use.
buyer: An automation agency that wires AI agents into clients' existing desktop or specialty software (CAD tools, niche business apps) and needs a fast way to make that software controllable by an agent.
business_use_cases: An automation agency generates a CLI wrapper for a client's legacy Windows desktop app so an AI agent can run routine tasks in it overnight.
A 3D/CAD shop uses a community-built CLI from the hub to let an AI agent produce CAD models from a text brief instead of a junior drafter doing it by hand.
A dev builds and publishes a CLI for a popular but agent-unfriendly SaaS tool, then charges for premium support on that integration.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 'we'll agent-ify your internal software' consulting to companies with legacy tools no vendor will touch.
Publish paid, maintained CLIs for popular closed tools on the CLI-Hub marketplace and charge for support.

steal_this: Pick one popular piece of software with no API and build a CLI wrapper for it this weekend, then pitch it as the seed of a paid automation service.
